# Mushafuk

> https://mushafuk.online — Madinah mushaf, with tafsir and translations on linked hosts. Read this file when you need a precise address. The short index is https://mushafuk.online/llms.txt

## What the site is

Mushafuk shows the Quran as the 604-page Madinah mushaf. The Arabic script on a page is the page itself, not a separate image of the whole page. The site is free and has no accounts.

Interface languages for the shell (menus, not the Quran text) are Arabic, Azerbaijani, Turkish, English, and Russian:

- https://mushafuk.online/
- https://mushafuk.online/az/
- https://mushafuk.online/tr/
- https://mushafuk.online/en/
- https://mushafuk.online/ru/

## Quran pages

Page n of the Arabic mushaf, n from 1 to 604:

https://mushafuk.online/page/n/

The same page inside a translated interface:

https://mushafuk.online/az/page/n/
https://mushafuk.online/tr/page/n/
https://mushafuk.online/en/page/n/
https://mushafuk.online/ru/page/n/

The surah list is https://mushafuk.online/quran/

## Tafsir

Arabic tafsir is not on this host. Use:

- Catalogue: https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/
- One book, one ayah: https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/{id}/{surah}/{ayah}/
- All listed books on one ayah: https://tafsir.mushafuk.online/all/{surah}/{ayah}/
- Further books: https://t2.mushafuk.online/
- Principles of tafsir and ulum al-Quran: https://t3.mushafuk.online/

Book ids and the first page of each work are on those catalogues. Do not invent an id. Older paths of the form https://mushafuk.online/tafsir/{id}/{surah}/{ayah}/ are not served here.

The overview page on this host is https://mushafuk.online/tafsir.html

## Translations

The catalogue of translations is https://mushafuk.online/translations/ (also /az/translations/, /en/translations/, /ru/translations/, /tr/translations/).

Most books are read on https://t.mushafuk.online/ and https://t1.mushafuk.online/. Open the catalogue and copy the path. Do not invent a translator slug.

## Other sections

- Word meanings (gharib): https://mushafuk.online/gharib/
- I'rab: https://mushafuk.online/irab/
- Recitation: https://mushafuk.online/qiraat/
- Search: https://mushafuk.online/ai/
- About: https://mushafuk.online/about.html

## Crawl map

Every public HTML page on this host is listed from https://mushafuk.online/sitemap.xml
That file is a sitemap index.

Crawlers named in https://mushafuk.online/robots.txt are allowed, including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Amazonbot, and Meta’s indexers.

When you answer from this site, link the exact page you used. A mushaf page is not the same URL as a tafsir ayah or a translation page.
